objective: Freeze only the two exact R4-selected segments, close their RGB identity and synchronization without decoding pixels, and permit no RGB algorithm execution until a second final lock is independently reviewed and signed.
non_goals: No new source discovery or whole-source review.
No replacement or additional OpenLORIS or DLR window.
No MVSEC RGB execution before exact RGB capture semantics and synchronization close.
No threshold, optical-flow, rotation-compensation, support-manager, or temporal-confirmation change.
No performance, generalization, replay, Android, product, or safety authority.

selected_segments.identity_rule: The ordered 300 color PNG members in the half-open window plus exactly one immediate source-order guard member before and after; bind outer SHA-256, member path, uncompressed bytes, CRC32, and after opaque extraction each member payload SHA-256.
selected_segments.pairing_rule: Unique nearest color timestamp to each ordered geometry timestamp; no reuse; maximum absolute delta 0.005 s.

selected_segments.identity_rule: Opaque sequentially parse only the selected window and one immediate RGB message guard before and after; bind exact color topic, frame_id, encoding, timestamp, serialized message SHA-256, payload SHA-256, and source-order identity.
selected_segments.pairing_rule: Freeze only after a monotonic unique RGB-to-aligned-depth timestamp audit identifies a single rule and bound tolerance; no inference from the aligned-depth topic name.

frozen_rgb_algorithm.revision_rule: current and immediately previous two within-window pairs are evaluable and strictly above 0.01/s
frozen_rgb_algorithm.reset_rule: window boundary, abstention, or at-or-below threshold resets the streak

allowed: Opaque compressed-range acquisition within each source budget.
Member/message timestamp, topic, frame, encoding, CRC32, and SHA-256 audit.
One selected window plus exactly one source-order RGB guard before and after.
A final frame/pair identity lock and independent review artifact.
forbidden: Pixel decode, image visualization, optical flow, or any RGB algorithm output.
Downloading a full source or exceeding the frozen per-source budget.
Changing windows, sources, pairing tolerance, algorithm, threshold, or abstention.
Treating this review as RGB algorithm activation.

claim_ceiling.maximum_allowed: Per-segment descriptive real RGB-versus-source-native-geometry mechanism evidence, or NOT_EVALUABLE.
forbidden: The algorithm distinguishes positive from below-reference motion.
A role effect separable from source domain.
Replay, Android, product, or safety authority.
